title: Cain's Lineage and Lamech's Song of Vengeance
description: Cain has a son named Enoch and builds a city named after him. The genealogy continues to Lamech, who takes two wives, Ada and Zillah. Their sons become the ancestors of nomads, musicians, and smiths: Jabal, Jubal, and Tubal-Cain. The story culminates in Lamech's song of vengeance, where he boasts of avenging himself seventy-seven times.
